text.tr: Program konteynerde neden `0.0.0.0`'da dinlemeli?
text.en: Why must the program listen on `0.0.0.0` in a container?

tr: localhost yalnızca konteynerin kendisi; dışarıdan gelen istek ulaşamaz
Docker başka adres kabul etmediği için
en: localhost is only the container itself; a request from outside cannot reach it
Because Docker accepts no other address

explanation.en: 0.0.0.0 = every address.

text.tr: Veritabanının yeri neden koda yazılmıyor, ortamdan okunuyor?
text.en: Why is the database location read from the environment rather than written in the code?

tr: Aynı imaj farklı ortamlarda farklı ayarla çalışabilsin diye
en: So the same image can run with different settings in different environments
Python does not run without environment variables

explanation.en: A default + an environment variable.

text.tr: `PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1` ne sağlar?
text.en: What does `PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1` do?

en: Output reaches docker logs without waiting

explanation.en: No buffering.

text.tr: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` ne sağlar?
text.en: What does `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` do?

explanation.en: They are useless in a container.

text.tr: Program SIGTERM'i yakalayıp kapanırsa `docker stop` ne kadar sürer (ölçtüğümüz)?
text.en: If the program catches SIGTERM and exits, how long does `docker stop` take (as we measured)?

explanation.en: 0.9 s, exit code 0.

text.tr: `requirements.txt` neden koddan önce kopyalanır?
text.en: Why is `requirements.txt` copied before the code?

tr: Kod değişince paket katmanları önbellekten gelsin diye
en: So the package layers come from the cache when the code changes

explanation.en: The often-changing last.

text.tr: `USER app` neden `pip install`'dan sonra yazılır?
text.en: Why is `USER app` written after `pip install`?

en: The image does not build if written before

explanation.en: The user only runs the program.

text.tr: `mkdir /data && chown app:app /data` olmadan ne olur (volume bağlıyken)?
text.en: What happens without `mkdir /data && chown app:app /data` (with a volume mounted)?

tr: unable to open database file: program yazamıyor
en: unable to open database file: the program cannot write

explanation.en: The folder is created owned by root.

text.tr: Boş bir adlı volume bağlandığı klasörün hangi özelliğini imajdan alır?
text.en: Which property of its folder does an empty named volume take from the image?

explanation.en: That is why chown is done in the image.

text.tr: `HEALTHCHECK` talimatı `compose.yaml`'daki healthcheck'ten nasıl ayrılır?
text.en: How does the `HEALTHCHECK` instruction differ from healthcheck in `compose.yaml`?

tr: İmajın içinde; imajı kim çalıştırırsa çalıştırsın denetim gelir
en: It is inside the image; whoever runs the image, the check comes along

explanation.en: compose.yaml only when run with Compose.

text.tr: Sağlık denetimi komutu nerede çalışır?
text.en: Where does the health check command run?

explanation.en: localhost there is the container itself.

text.tr: Denetim komutunun çıkış kodu 1 ise?
text.en: If the check command's exit code is 1?

en: The container is removed at once

explanation.en: 0 healthy, 1 unhealthy.

text.tr: `--interval=5s --retries=3` ile denetim hep başarısızsa durum ne zaman `unhealthy` olur?
text.en: With `--interval=5s --retries=3`, if the check always fails, when does the state become `unhealthy`?

explanation.en: 3 failures in a row × 5 s.

text.tr: İlk denetim geçene kadar `docker ps` ne gösterir?
text.en: Until the first check passes, what does `docker ps` show?

explanation.en: Then healthy.

text.tr: Denetim neden ayrı bir `healthcheck.py` ile yazıldı?
text.en: Why was the check written in a separate `healthcheck.py`?

tr: slim imajda curl yok ve port ortamdan okunabiliyor
Docker Python dışında komut kabul etmez
en: The slim image has no curl, and the port can be read from the environment
Docker accepts no command except Python

explanation.en: When PORT changes, so does the check.

text.tr: Unhealthy bir konteynerde denetimin neden düştüğünü nereden görürsün?
text.en: Where do you see why the check fails in an unhealthy container?

explanation.en: The output of the last checks is there.

text.tr: `.env` neden `.dockerignore`'da?
text.en: Why is `.env` in `.dockerignore`?

tr: İçindeki ayarlar ve parolalar imajla herkese gitmesin
en: So its settings and passwords do not travel to everyone with the image

explanation.en: Settings are given at run time.

text.tr: `env_file: .env` ile Dockerfile'daki `ENV` aynı değişkeni verirse hangisi geçerli?
text.en: If `env_file: .env` and the Dockerfile's `ENV` give the same variable, which wins?

explanation.en: ENV is the default, .env that environment's setting.

text.tr: `docker compose down` sonrası `up` yapınca not neden yerinde?
text.en: Why is the note still there after `docker compose down` then `up`?

tr: Veritabanı adlı volume'da; down volume'u silmez
en: The database is in a named volume; down does not remove the volume
The note was written into the image

explanation.en: down -v would remove it.

text.tr: `restart: unless-stopped` ne yapar?
text.en: What does `restart: unless-stopped` do?

tr: Program çökerse yeniden başlatır; sen durdurduysan başlatmaz
en: Restarts the program if it crashes; not if you stopped it
Deletes it when the computer starts

explanation.en: For long-lived services.

text.tr: Kodu değiştirdin; `docker compose up -d` değişikliği göstermiyor. Ne eksik?
text.en: You changed the code; `docker compose up -d` does not show the change. What is missing?

explanation.en: up does not rebuild the image by itself.

text.tr: Bu projede imajın diskteki 176 MB'ının çoğu nereden geliyor?
text.en: In this project, where do most of the image's 176 MB on disk come from?

explanation.en: Our layers are ~115 KB.

text.tr: PowerShell'de `curl` yerine neden `curl.exe` yazılır?
text.en: Why write `curl.exe` instead of `curl` in PowerShell?

tr: curl orada başka bir komutun takma adı
en: curl is an alias of another command there

explanation.en: The real curl program is curl.exe.

text.tr: `Exited (137)` neyi gösterir?
text.en: What does `Exited (137)` show?

tr: Program SIGTERM'i duymadı ve 10 saniye sonra öldürüldü (ya da bellek)
en: The program did not hear SIGTERM and was killed after 10 seconds (or memory)

explanation.tr: CMD exec biçiminde mi, sinyal yakalanıyor mu?
explanation.en: Is CMD in exec form, is the signal caught?
